description: Data host: block paths outside /datasets/, /query/, /qc/ with .js or .pdf
expression: (http.host eq "data.hypoexplorer.com" and (not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/datasets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/query/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/qc/")) or not (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".js") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".pdf")) or http.request.uri.path contains ".." or http.request.uri.path contains "//" or len(http.request.uri.path) gt 256))
